title: rostellularia heterocarpoides
intro: Rostellularia heterocarpoides, commonly known as Green Coral Pea, is a plant species native to Australia and parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antispasmodic, antihistamine, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relax muscles, reduce allergy symptoms, and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Rostellularia heterocarpoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
